ipratropium.t: 4 CONTRAINDICATIONS SPIRIVA RESPIMAT is contraindicated in patients with a hypersensitivity to tiotropium, ipratropium, or any component of this product [see Warnings and Precautions (5.2) ] .
Hypersensitivity to tiotropium, ipratropium, or any component of this product.

atropine.t: Given the similar structural formula of atropine to tiotropium, patients with a history of hypersensitivity reactions to atropine or its derivatives should be closely monitored for similar hypersensitivity reactions to SPIRIVA RESPIMAT.

albuterol.t: If this occurs, it should be treated immediately with an inhaled short-acting beta 2 -agonist such as albuterol.
